claim_steps: Confirm an incorporated startup under 10 years old with a working website, a clear NVIDIA-technology use case, and active operation by at least one founder.
Ineligible: consulting/outsourced-development firms, cryptocurrency-associated companies, cloud providers, resellers/distributors, and public companies.
Apply at nvidia.com/en-us/startups with business/product details and a company pitch deck; no fees, deadlines, or cohorts.
If accepted, access free cloud credits, free self-paced courses and discounted expert-led workshops, SDKs, and preferred hardware pricing; Capital Connect investor exposure depends on eligibility.

social_proof.author: Ksenia Moskalenko
social_proof.text: OPPORTUNITY: @nvidia will give your AI startup free training, cloud credits, and VC intros. No VC funding required, no equity, no deadline. This is NVIDIA Inception program. Who qualifies: at least one developer, a working website, officially incorporated, under 10 years old.

Inception is a free program that guides AI startups through the NVIDIA platform and ecosystem. Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners. Hone critical skills with free self-paced technical courses and discounted expert-led workshops. No application fees, deadlines, or cohorts.

summary: NVIDIA Inception is a free, rolling startup program (verified Sep 13, 2026): free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners, free self-paced technical courses and discounted expert-led workshops, latest SDKs and model libraries, preferred pricing on NVIDIA hardware/software, investor exposure via Capital Connect, and go-to-market support. Any funding stage may apply; no application or membership fees, equity requirements, deadlines, or cohorts. Members must maintain a working website, be officially incorporated, be less than 10 years old, have a clear use case for NVIDIA technology, and be actively operated by at least one founder. The application requires a company pitch deck. The embedded Sep 13, 2026 X post is historical corroboration; its developer wording is not current official eligibility. Consulting/outsourced-development firms, cryptocurrency-associated companies, cloud providers, resellers/distributors, and public companies are ineligible. Applications are reviewed by NVIDIA; Capital Connect access depends on eligibility. Distinct from the NVIDIA NIM free trial and Inception Labs listings.
